title: Table with many fields
description:
Code-style rule — base tables with more than 100 fields. A very wide table often mixes several concerns that belong in separate tables.

Based on the PMD rule TooManyFields — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_codestyle.html#toomanyfields Threshold adjustable via the header slider (default 100).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Very wide tables are hard to understand and usually under-normalised.
rule.remediation: Split unrelated field groups into related child tables.
